# Recommended AI consulting firms in Saudi Arabia

If your company wants to develop an AI strategy and then implement it in real business operations, I recommend evaluating a mix of **specialist Saudi AI consultancies and larger international consulting firms**\. The best choice depends on whether you need executive-level strategy, hands-on AI engineering, enterprise-wide transformation, or all three.

I reviewed firms with Saudi market presence and publicly described AI strategy or implementation capabilities. The shortlist below is a starting point for vendor evaluation, not a ranking based on independently verified project outcomes.

## My recommended shortlist

![علوم وتقنيات / جمعية الذكاء الاصطناعي توقّع مذكرة تفاهم مع شركة Bilytica لبناء القدرات الوطنية في مجال البرمجة](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dD1eqwWRtFwZ4oQNx5FPBIaovjfn-yfTlSUegFXO4EiHU68J69pqWc0X4QCTWW2DfbDI9m3f5oZRHQAxY2_jjBJbUDIMELJxKo26PfKe73J1VjLeuFqWr6ppguifKBo0ma6fYuI__bBZh5YvWYdUp79k13Ihx4Eshkn836H6ii60_v5b9P79ivn2cvquEItV?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Bilytica

(Strong all-round specialist)

Riyadh · [Official website](https://bilytica.com/consulting-solutions/)

Bilytica describes an AI-native consulting offering spanning business strategy, AI solution design, data foundations and execution. Its published services include executive workshops, use-case prioritization, ROI modelling, operating-model design and governance aligned with Saudi requirements. [bilytica.com](https://bilytica.com/consulting-solutions/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Companies seeking a specialist partner that can connect business strategy with technical delivery.

**Ask about\:** Comparable production deployments, named delivery leads, and how benefits are measured after launch.

---

![Accenture Ventures — Think Different | BEAMSTART](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/A3Ct6d_Z34DlaX862wTV3j7uCNkt4xwspsLwEOuPZDDWBnRYGcQ53ChE7kjsDoFKu-R_Ouc8mOKZit8OK5Iqqz3DXm2wF68qfYlL0uCTXjc_AnNadytJrAsTvMMBcJ5Tv2Stj7k3WnRvIiyHERhRrZjMcIooIezpxqpyXeJnDGTU_sTmkz_1OL8H_8CdpPma?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. Accenture

Riyadh · [Official website](https://www.accenture.com/sa-en)

A strong candidate for large, complex AI transformation programmes that require strategy, data platforms, cloud architecture, systems integration and ongoing operations under one delivery programme. Accenture has a Riyadh office and broader international technology delivery capabilities. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJ73YLJwDjLj4RfEEEBzA7l6M&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.techvendorindex.com](https://www.techvendorindex.com/regions/saudi-arabia/ai-ml-consulting/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJQ0zFY6bPwxUR73P1LDXqndU&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJF4H5RwABLz4RTEVCCF9mQ7I&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Large enterprises, complex legacy environments and multi-department transformation.

**Ask about\:** Saudi-based delivery capacity, implementation partners, total programme cost and knowledge transfer to your team.

---

![Crux Technology | AI & Digital Transformation Company in Saudi Arabia | Cloud, Data & Enterprise Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nTlw94RoJmCBdJ5ABJv5OkJ2p1vMf3vkDmvwgb6mEkjtp3GIvb50lh2yXI5VjVyP0zYjxcuWlNgnYrrdiPtuuQFWnC25gDoap57szC8gx2o9dWDJgoxf5EAyGoUPvNR50oSt_eNRcwTvw-9tZGnOEzKMd822r39mzWdKmcAcwj-biPpoOt6uXhY7bPfQs0vh?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. Crux Technology

Saudi Arabia · [AI strategy services](https://crux.sa/services/ai-strategy-consulting)

Crux presents a strategy-to-execution model covering AI opportunity discovery, business cases, readiness assessments, 12–24-month roadmaps, AI governance and technical implementation. It also highlights Saudi regulatory considerations, including PDPL. [crux.sa](https://crux.sa/services/ai-strategy-consulting?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Companies wanting a defined AI roadmap that leads directly into implementation.

**Ask about\:** Customer references, actual production systems delivered, and evidence supporting its stated performance metrics.

---

![Contact Us
– Apex Arabia](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/_DMg4QolbvfGIN6WP-hk4YJMtWDpz6DTd5adHyqaUuQklhfVwTJchoRiUR8XSCnewNJyUal8enopeKs6x-mDUSWF3cOFg2b6Mx7FzhBBcu_odFRKrxXe5NWZhK03cM5ljpXOEo40BWk4sgtNlqNK1k2O9fn6AYtBta-VC2r8FdmHGIMjgcu3qEWpPTw3r9wn?purpose=fullsize)

## 4\. Apex AI Arabia

Jeddah and Riyadh · [Official website](https://apexaiarabia.com/)

Apex describes an end-to-end approach covering AI strategy and readiness, data and infrastructure, solution development, deployment and continuous improvement. Its stated target sectors include financial services, government, energy and healthcare. [apexaiarabia.com](https://apexaiarabia.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Organizations that want to work with an AI-focused provider with a stated presence in both Jeddah and Riyadh.

**Ask about\:** Sector-specific references, integration with your existing systems, support arrangements and the team's technical credentials.

---

![Вы не робот?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/n-5IqIgnn2smq93nZAjg7NzZd5epUfjoQsakX_276OLoVyk61k0-oQqWT2fJKaDWyjKHAGKxn79USV2hNLKIML0M2n-dUNl_sfCpYUuwvvyY2FSnmzuAC1ikxcqAGD7x9SkVoLUuU0Vfd_muO9kRr5TA8FBXkPf9At5ENfEIZTpTmiDcjpQahBbv41FPHypX?purpose=fullsize)

## 5\. Pulse Innovation Consulting

Riyadh · [Official website](https://picsaudi.com/)

PIC combines strategy and value-realization advisory with an AI and data practice. Its positioning emphasizes measurable business outcomes, leadership engagement and transferring capabilities to the client's own team. [picsaudi.com](https://picsaudi.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Leadership teams that want to link AI investments to financial or operational results rather than simply launch technology pilots.

**Ask about\:** The precise engineering resources available in-house and which team will build and operate your AI solutions.

---

![Deloitte Jobs - 24 offerte di lavoro - talendo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hG4n0AcZB0o-wgxHA2xQy4bXyTUc4N6j-O1bqz5aGBbPmVwYOu8yHtXC1YbJyszi9HIFP-MJi3uKRa1KRhTGJhBvUAVL05Fryw6hzj-rfX9XzcZdLAqXY4dHn1m5YadmqPiTnVbrGwyinTWQLO7AUAjISUlLf69V-obvsnDCra4Pz9HfAeTmUaj6GQrU9b3P?purpose=fullsize)

## 6\. Deloitte

Jeddah and wider Saudi operations · [Official website](https://www.deloitte.com/middle-east/en.html)

Deloitte is worth considering when AI must be integrated into a broader transformation programme involving operating models, risk management, controls, finance, cybersecurity or regulatory requirements. Its Saudi presence includes a Jeddah office. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJ73YLJwDjLj4RfEEEBzA7l6M&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.techvendorindex.com](https://www.techvendorindex.com/regions/saudi-arabia/ai-ml-consulting/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJQ0zFY6bPwxUR73P1LDXqndU&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJF4H5RwABLz4RTEVCCF9mQ7I&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Regulated industries and companies combining AI adoption with enterprise risk, governance or business transformation.

**Ask about\:** The specific AI engineering team assigned to the project, rather than relying on the firm's general consulting credentials.

---

![IBM Consulting 로고 | brandB 브랜드비](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gppsH6VUrgRQKR42tYE1DZsvru0p0FTM9BowyT1VWx-ykhfwtRfF1QFIZbXU8G1zybmILkag0W2BDAiMTbSHpIV4Wjrk8XaeO6t7ese1fJZyQO-Wbm9-esdBqMJN88pNWQXNr9MjBLpnxX1Q5dYMCOq0re4coaY4QhP9rloxHn6Cgx0SE9V-iXRJ6DQcz_-O?purpose=fullsize)

## 7\. IBM Consulting

Riyadh · [Official website](https://www.ibm.com/consulting)

IBM Consulting is another candidate for enterprise AI, particularly where AI must work with existing enterprise data, hybrid cloud, established applications and governance processes. Its broader ecosystem includes IBM's enterprise AI technologies. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJ73YLJwDjLj4RfEEEBzA7l6M&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.techvendorindex.com](https://www.techvendorindex.com/regions/saudi-arabia/ai-ml-consulting/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJQ0zFY6bPwxUR73P1LDXqndU&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJF4H5RwABLz4RTEVCCF9mQ7I&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Large organizations with complex IT environments or a need to integrate AI into existing enterprise platforms.

**Ask about\:** Whether the proposed architecture is vendor-neutral, and how licensing, infrastructure and long-term operating costs compare with alternatives.

## Which firm should you choose?

| Your main requirement | My first choice to evaluate |
|--------|--------|
| Strategy plus hands-on AI implementation | Bilytica or Crux Technology |
| Enterprise-wide transformation at scale | Accenture |
| AI advisory and business-value realization | Pulse Innovation Consulting |
| Local specialist with a stated Jeddah presence | Apex AI Arabia |
| AI governance and wider business transformation | Deloitte |
| Complex enterprise data and IT integration | IBM Consulting |


These are fit-based recommendations, not a claim that one firm is objectively the best. Confirm the proposed team's experience and delivery record before selecting a partner.

## How I would structure the engagement

Whichever firm you choose, ask for a programme with four concrete phases\:

**1\. AI readiness and opportunity assessment**

Review business processes, data quality, IT architecture, workforce capabilities and existing AI initiatives. Identify and prioritize use cases by value, feasibility and risk.

---

**2\. AI strategy and business case**

Produce a 12–24-month roadmap, investment estimates, build-versus-buy decisions, target architecture, governance requirements and measurable KPIs.

---

**3\. Pilot and production implementation**

Build one or two high-value solutions, integrate them with company systems, evaluate accuracy and security, and measure the business impact before scaling.

---

**4\. Scale, govern and transfer capabilities**

Establish AI policies, monitoring, employee training, ownership and ongoing support. Ensure the company can maintain and improve the solutions over time.

For Saudi operations, also ask how the firm addresses the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), applicable SDAIA guidance, data residency requirements and any sector-specific regulations relevant to your business.

The right shortlist will differ substantially between a mid-sized company looking to automate workflows and a large enterprise building an AI transformation programme.

## 6\. Deloitte

Jeddah and wider Saudi operations · [Official website](https://www.deloitte.com/middle-east/en.html)

Deloitte is worth considering when AI must be integrated into a broader transformation programme involving operating models, risk management, controls, finance, cybersecurity or regulatory requirements. Its Saudi presence includes a Jeddah office. Riyadh · [Official website](https://www.ibm.com/consulting)

IBM Consulting is another candidate for enterprise AI, particularly where AI must work with existing enterprise data, hybrid cloud, established applications and governance processes. Its broader ecosystem includes IBM's enterprise AI technologies. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJ73YLJwDjLj4RfEEEBzA7l6M&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.techvendorindex.com](https://www.techvendorindex.com/regions/saudi-arabia/ai-ml-consulting/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJQ0zFY6bPwxUR73P1LDXqndU&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJF4H5RwABLz4RTEVCCF9mQ7I&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Large organizations with complex IT environments or a need to integrate AI into existing enterprise platforms.

**Ask about\:** Whether the proposed architecture is vendor-neutral, and how licensing, infrastructure and long-term operating costs compare with alternatives.

items.markdown:
These are fit-based recommendations, not a claim that one firm is objectively the best. Confirm the proposed team's experience and delivery record before selecting a partner.

## How I would structure the engagement

Whichever firm you choose, ask for a programme with four concrete phases\:

**1\. AI readiness and opportunity assessment**

Review business processes, data quality, IT architecture, workforce capabilities and existing AI initiatives. Identify and prioritize use cases by value, feasibility and risk.

---

**2\. AI strategy and business case**

Produce a 12–24-month roadmap, investment estimates, build-versus-buy decisions, target architecture, governance requirements and measurable KPIs.

---

**3\. Pilot and production implementation**

Build one or two high-value solutions, integrate them with company systems, evaluate accuracy and security, and measure the business impact before scaling.

---

**4\. Scale, govern and transfer capabilities**

Establish AI policies, monitoring, employee training, ownership and ongoing support. Ensure the company can maintain and improve the solutions over time.

For Saudi operations, also ask how the firm addresses the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), applicable SDAIA guidance, data residency requirements and any sector-specific regulations relevant to your business.
